text:
Priya K: ok handoff from me — primary (EMEA) is closing, I left notes below. Big thing: we have a 2hr coverage gap between EMEA -> NA overlap tonight (00:30 UTC). Primary for the overlap is Michael. Pls confirm you can take async pages for that window.

Priya K: open issues to be aware of: intermittent 5xx on /v1/generate (p99 latency spike), KV-cache miss storm yesterday evening, and Dedicated pool `ded-prod-a` is at 82% utilization. not urgent but triage if pages come in.

OncallBot: Pager triggered last 24h: Incident 4043 (api-5xx-spike) - status: resolved, followup required. Link: https://redwood.example/incidents/4043 :spiral_notepad:

Priya K: runbook links I used — put these in your bookmarks:
- KV cache throttling + warmstart: https://redwood.example/runbooks/kv-cache-warmstart
- API 5xx triage checklist: https://redwood.example/runbooks/api-5xx-triage
- Dedicated pool scaling: https://redwood.example/runbooks/dedicated-scale

Michael S: I can cover the overlap window. quick Q: what's the recommended immediate step if p99 spikes again? restart router pods or trigger cache warmstart?

Priya K: preference order: 1) check prefix cache metrics -> if miss rate > 30% then trigger warmstart (link above). 2) if upstream errors > 10% then restart the inference-router group (kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-router -n prod). 3) if still bad, failover route to regional fallback model via routing policy (see runbook).

Anya L: adding a short command cheat-sheet for fast execs:```bash
# tail logs for router
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=inference-router -c router --tail=200
# restart router
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/inference-router
# trigger KV warmstart (internal job)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" \
 https://internal.redwood/api/warmstart -d '{"pool":"ded-prod-a","mode":"prefix"}'
```

Ravi P: customer impact note — if /v1/generate p99 > 2.5s we should create an incident with sev=2 and tag affected tenants. yesterday we saw a small cohort (orgs: acme-inc, beta-saas) with timeouts. make sure to include request IDs from logs.

Michael S: noted. I'll add a watch on p99 and a small alert to SMS for the overlap window. Also, will validate Dedicated pool autoscaler settings (min replicas) — I saw min=2 might be low for bursts.

Priya K: quick mitigation tips to stash in your head: short-term = warmstart + router restart; mid-term = bump pool min replicas or enable burst capacity; longer = enable prefix caching per-tenant and enable LRU->TTL tuning.

OncallBot: Reminder: to acknowledge and silence followups use `/oncall ack 1726004321` in the bridge channel.

Anya L: if you need to revert a canary routing change: go to Console -> Routing -> History -> rollback (id shown on the canary row). Also safe rollback command:```bash
# rollback canary via infra tool
infractl route rollback --canary-id=ci-2023-09-23 --force
```

Michael S: thanks — taking handover now. I'll run the pre-overlap checklist at T+5m and post a short status update. :thumbsup:

Priya K: thanks team. Leaving a final note — contact lists in runbook include SRE paging roster and on-call escalation numbers. If you hit repeated 5xx after restarts, escalate to Eng-Platform and Eng-Runtime (they have hooks for kernel toggles).

Ravi P: if anything spikes, ping me directly. I'll be monitoring logs through the window.

Michael S: status-update (T+6m): added p99 watch, manual alert rule live, checking ded-prod-a autoscaler now.

Priya K: perfect. good luck — logging off.
